sloka: जडी कृते तदा लोके रामे वर धनुर् धरे ।निर्वीर्यो जामदग्न्यो असौ रमो रामम् उदैक्षत ॥१-७६-११॥
transliteration: jaḍī kṛte tadā loke rāme vara dhanur dhare ।nirvīryo jāmadagnyo asau ramo rāmam udaikṣata ॥1-76-11॥

translations.english: Then when Rama stretched the great bow, the world became motionless. The son of Jamadagni, Parasurama, bereft of prowess gazed at him with astonishment.
translations.hindi: महीध्रक के महाबली कीतिरात हुए ओर कीतिरात के राजि महारोमा हुए
